mapper.sql: select id, project_id, patient_id, patient_name, eval_date, eval_result, score, evaluator, eval_detail, remark, ai_analysis, ai_measures, ai_model, ai_status, ai_time, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from ai_evaluation_data
mapper.select:
select r.id, r.project_name as projectName, r.research_synopsis as researchSynopsis, r.patient_num as patientNum, r.pending_tasks_num as pendingTasksNum, r.ongoing_tasks_num as ongoingTasksNum, r.completed_tasks_num as completedTasksNum, r.publish_time as publishTime, d.disease_name as diseaseName, (select count(*) from ai_evaluation_data e where e.project_id = r.id) as dataCount from research_info r left join research_diseases d on d.disease_id = r.disease_type_id
r.del_flag = '0' and r.research_status = '1' and r.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%')
order by r.publish_time desc, r.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_evaluation_data (project_id, patient_id, patient_name, eval_date, eval_result, score, evaluator, eval_detail, remark, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{patientId}, #{patientName}, #{evalDate}, #{evalResult}, #{score}, #{evaluator}, #{evalDetail}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, now())
mapper.delete:
delete from ai_evaluation_data where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select pr.record_id as recordId, pr.patient_id as patientId, pr.research_id as researchId, pr.follow_id as followId, pr.name as name, pr.stage_num as stageNum, pr.stage_add_num as stageAddNum, pr.fill_time as fillTime, pr.fill_status as fillStatus, pr.follow_status as followStatus, pr.question_status as questionStatus, pi.patient_name as patientName from patient_record pr inner join patient_info pi on pi.patient_id = pr.patient_id where pr.research_id = #{projectId} and pr.fill_status = '1' and pr.follow_status != '-1' order by pr.patient_id asc, pr.fill_time asc, pr.record_id asc
